line: Crowley's Prince of Wands: Vau of the Name (pdf p139); the airy part of Fire and the span from Cancer to Leo (pdf p145).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Princes (pdf p139) and on the Prince of Wands (pdf p145).

quotes.quote: The Princes represent the Forces of the letter Vau in the Name.
The Prince of Wands represents the airy part of Fire, with its faculty of expanding and volatilising.

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Cancer to the 20th degree of Leo (pdf p145); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: He rules from the 21st degree of Cancer to the 20th degree of Leo.
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Prince of Wands (pdf p145).

quotes.quote: The moral qualities appropriate to this figure are swiftness and strength.
